mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% and rises by more than 0.2 percentage points in the past month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0 and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 3.0% and sustained for 3 months), a rising CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed delays rate cuts.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS rising for 3 months AND CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3.0%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate profit growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) falls below 1.0% annualized, it signals a slowing economy that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 < 1.0% annualized, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 4.0%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a potential peak in the business cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and HOUST declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
